name: 5i5j Holding Group Co., Ltd.
summary: 5i5j Holding Group Co., Ltd. operates as a real estate services provider, extending its operations across China and into international markets. The company's comprehensive portfolio encompasses property brokerage, residential and commercial asset management, and various ancillary property services. Established in 1959, 5i5j Holding Group Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Beijing, China. It rebranded to its current name in April 2018, having previously been known as Kunming Sinobright (Group) Co., Ltd.
